published.citation: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: Teff 28,513 (+2,388/-2,923) K: 28513 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.06353

temperature.note: S2 is observed only in the near-infrared (the SINFONI H- and K-band spectra of Habibi et al. 2017); no spectrum of it covers visible light, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
